87183569.title: HMS_Hyperion_(1807)
87183569.extract:
HMS Hyperion (1807) was a 32-gun frigate of the Royal Navy, copied from the design of the French frigate Magicienne. Commissioned in 1808, she served in various capacities during the Napoleonic Wars and the War of 1812. Notably, in 1818, HMS Hyperion was involved in the capture of the Rattlesnake after a 48-hour chase. The ship was broken up in 1833 after a relatively short career.

The lead section would be written as follows:

HMS Hyperion (1807) was a 32-gun frigate of the Royal Navy, commissioned in 1808. During her service, she participated in various missions, including escorting convoys and patrolling the Caribbean. Notable during her career was the capture of the Rattlesnake in 1818. Despite her contributions, she was broken up in 1833.
